messages:
customer_john: Hey team — hitting a reproducible failure when calling tools via the TS SDK. Works on our server once, then subsequent calls error with schema validation: "invalid type for 'file_b64' expected string". cc @support

support_amy: thanks for the ping — can you paste the exact error and a minimal repro? which SDK version?

customer_john: error dump: `400 Bad Request: schema_validation_failed: {"tool":"ocr","args":{"file_b64": {"type":"Buffer"}}}`. We're using @redwood/sdk-js 0.9.7. Repro steps: call tool with node Buffer.from(file) as arg.

eng_bob: @customer_john can you show the snippet you pass into the client? TS code often serializes Buffers to objects if you stringify wrong.

customer_john: sure — code: ```js const file = fs.readFileSync('scan.png'); await client.callTool('ocr', { file_b64: Buffer.from(file) }); ``` No extra JSON.stringify.

devx_carla: that should just work — the SDK should base64-encode Buffers automatically. tagging @eng_bob to triage. any race/local env specifics?

qa_dan: I can reproduce locally with 0.9.7. If I send Buffer directly first call passes, second call fails with same schema error. Looks like the serializer intermittently emits an object with `type: 'Buffer', data: [...]` instead of a base64 string.

eng_bob: interesting. suspecting a cross-runtime marshaling bug where our toJSON hook for Buffer isn't invoked in some cases (maybe when mixing sync and async code). Can you run a quick trace and post console.log(JSON.stringify(arg)) for the failing request?

qa_dan: here's what I saw: first request payload -> `{"file_b64":"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANS..."}` second request payload -> `{"file_b64":{"type":"Buffer","data":[137,80,78,71,...]}}`. So indeed it flips to Node Buffer literal.

support_amy: customer-facing note: workaround is to send explicit base64 string: `file_b64: file.toString('base64')`. pls confirm if that helps you while we patch. :thumbsup:

customer_john: confirmed workaround works. but we need stable SDK fix — this causes production failures for our batch workers.

eng_bob: digging in. found a code path in SDK where we clone args with structuredClone(windowedValue) when running in bundled environments; structuredClone preserves Buffer as object depending on polyfill. That explains sporadic object variant.

devx_carla: patch idea: normalize tool args before sending: if value is Buffer or has `type==='Buffer' && Array.isArray(data)` convert to base64 string. Add unit tests for cross-bundle cases.

eng_bob: creating PR now that adds a serializer pass: `if (isNodeBuffer(v) || (v?.type==='Buffer' && Array.isArray(v.data))) return Buffer.from(v.data||v).toString('base64')`. Will also add integration test that simulates structuredClone polyfill.

ci_bot: CI started for branch fix/serializer-buffer-normalize (#3287) — 12 checks running.

eng_bob: @qa_dan can you verify PR on your repro matrix (0.9.7 + bundle env + worker pool)?

qa_dan: running tests now. updated client from local branch, re-ran the previous sequence: repeated calls remain stable, payload is always `{"file_b64":"iVBORw0KGg..."}`. No failures after 50 iterations.

eng_bob: great. planning to ship patch release 0.9.8 today. I'll include release notes and the workaround explanation.

support_amy: customer_john — we'll push 0.9.8 and notify you when available. ETA ~3h. In the meantime please keep using base64 string workaround.

customer_john: thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround. Please also add a note in docs about Buffer behavior in bundled runtimes (webpack/rollup) and recommend toString('base64') or upgrade.

devx_carla: noted — I'll add a short section in SDK docs and example snippets for Node/browser bundlers.

ci_bot: CI succeeded for #3287, merging and triggering release pipeline.

eng_bob: release 0.9.8 published: fixes Buffer serialization edge-case in tool calls. Patch includes tests and docs.

customer_john: we upgraded and verified — problem resolved. closing on our side. :tada:

support_amy: marking as resolved. Thanks everyone!
